comparison.objective: Mix flour and liquid into dough while stabilizing a loose bowl; candidate adjusts and locks a mechanical gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a vessel while sweeping a spoon through granular ingredients; no coaxial driver/wrench coupling or setting retention.
comparison.success_condition: Scores mixed-flour share while penalizing tipping and material loss; candidate scores opening angle, locked retention, cycling, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual stabilization is generic; mixing distributed material does not test countertorque locking of an adjustable stop.
